description: Estimate capital gains tax on an investment sale — total gain, tax owed and net proceeds. Educational only, not tax advice.

faqs.a: Assets held one year or less are usually taxed as short-term gains (ordinary rates); longer holdings qualify as long-term gains at a different rate. This tool lets you enter the applicable rate for either case.
Gain = (sell price − buy price) × quantity. Tax owed = gain × your tax rate, applied only when the gain is positive.
A loss produces no tax in this estimate — the loss amount is shown so you can discuss tax-loss harvesting with a professional.
faqs.q: What if I sold at a loss?

howto: Enter buy price, sell price and quantity.
Pick short-term or long-term holding and enter the applicable tax rate.
Read your gain, estimated tax and net proceeds.
title: Capital Gains Calculator
